An easy way to work for Anna

TEI as a preferred entry with prepared support. Format and specific host are separate decisions.

StepWhat's happening?Who's wearing it?
1. EditRecord text and comment in the documented model.Anna; Establishment with advice
2. CheckValidate and view local preview; expert opinion remains necessary.Anna; Test rules with advice
3. Hold onCommit, regular external comparison to private working repository.Anna; Hosting with clear responsibility
4. ReleaseCheck professional quality, rights, protection, metadata and achievable history; generate curated export.Anna; technical/technical assistance as required
5. SpendPublication data, static website, PDF/print if applicable.Agreed publication service; technical responsibility with Anna

Two additional tasks

Safety: Regular commits and pushes to a reliably operated Uni-GitLab can secure Anna's edition files with history. Anna tests the way back through a fresh copy, documents the scope and adds a backup path for external files. An additional independent copy improves protection.

Archiving: Metadata, terms of use, persistent identification and long-term responsible institution agree separately. Git hosting does not guarantee this.

Prepare for Change

Test local build, export, rights and handover. Git data and history are only one part; treat platform data and external objects separately. Place of work and place of publication can be different.
